newsitem.title: USA: Clinton parties with Albright as she turns 60.
newsitem.headline: Clinton parties with Albright as she turns 60.

text.p: President Bill Clinton on Saturday joined Secretary of State Madeleine Albright for a second night of festivities in honour of her 60th birthday, joining a party of 200 people in an exclusive Washington neighbourhood.

Guests attending the semi-formal party thrown by Albright's family at Georgetown's Halcyon House included prominent Democrats, Republicans and foreign diplomats, including Saudi Arabian ambassador Prince Bandar al-Sultan.

Senate Foreign Relations Commmittee Chairman Jesse Helms, a conservate Republican from North Carolina, CIA Director-nominee George Tenet, NATO Secretary General Xavier Solana, Federal Reserve Board Chairman Alan Greenspan and former Democratic vice presidential candidate Geraldine Ferraro were among the other guests in attendance.
The Czech-born Albright hosted a party at her Georgetown home on Friday night and the guests included Clinton, Czech President Vaclav Havel and National Security Adviser Samuel "Sandy" Berger.
